Final categorization: EXCLUDED

Justification: This paper is a review article on climate change impacts and adaptations in wine production, focusing on viticulture, grape yield, wine quality, and shifting geographic suitability under climate change. Although it discusses changes in land use implicitly through viticultural expansion and emerging new wine regions, it does not focus on land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or spatially explicit modeling of LULC changes at national scale. It synthesizes climate impacts and adaptation strategies rather than quantitatively predicting or mapping future LULC scenarios. Therefore, it does not meet the criteria for REVIEW (which requires focus on LULC future prediction) nor for research papers focused on LULC prediction. Hence, it is excluded based on the screening criteria.
